title: Problem adding treatment with more than 2 decimal
symptom: When adding a treatment with 3 or more decimal places, the last 2 or 3 are considered as units of insulin, e.g., 3.125 becomes 25 units, 0.148 becomes 48 units, 1.2563 becomes 563 units. The same issue occurs for carbs with specific differences.
cause: The problem is suspected to be in Simulation.class, specifically in the createTreatment method where a regex replaceAll is used that incorrectly splits numbers with more than two decimal places.
fix: The issue was reported as solved for insulin units in version b978bec-2020.11.27, but remains for carbs. The thread was closed as a duplicate of issue #565, which presumably contains the fix.
evidence_quote: hello, just tested on versionb978bec-2020.11.27 and it seems solved for units. The issue remains for carbs
